status: PUBLIC DEVNET DEPLOYMENT PASS / NO B2 STATE ACCOUNTS EXIST / MULTISIG RUN STOPPED AT THE DISCLOSED SPEND CAP
claim: The B2 program is deployed on public devnet and the bytes on the cluster are the bytes that were tested locally. Nothing has been done with it there: no policy, no vault, no deposit.

deployment.upgrade_authority_note: a retained devnet-only test key held outside every repository at mode 0600; this is not a production authority and no production ceremony has occurred
deployment.dump_back_verification: solana program dump reproduces the local artifact byte for byte; cmp reports no difference
deployment.program_data_rent: 2.55736152 SOL, exactly the figure solana rent 367309 predicts
deployment.no_rebuild_was_needed: unlike B1, the declared program id already matched the retained keypair, so the artifact tested locally is the artifact on the cluster. B1 needed a 192-byte declare_id delta bridge; this deployment needs none.

what_exists_on_devnet: the program account and its ProgramData, and nothing else belonging to B2
what_does_not_exist_on_devnet: no PolicyWindow, no MarketInput, no CovenantVault, no token vault, no Approval
no deposit of any kind, no token controlled by the program
the multisig half of the run failed before open_policy executed, so B2 has never been invoked on a public cluster

why_the_run_stopped.reason: the disclosed spend cap, not a program failure
why_the_run_stopped.judgement: 95.4% of the cap is spent. 25_B2_SQUADS_AUTHORITY_DEVNET_DISCLOSURE.md section 5 requires stopping and reporting when spend approaches the cap rather than raising it, so the run stops here and the remaining steps need a Founder decision.
why_the_run_stopped.first_attempt_failure: the public devnet endpoint returned 429 repeatedly and a just-created Squads VaultTransaction account was not readable when the execute step needed it. Propagation waits were added; the fix was not exercised, because the cap was reached first.

operational_defect_found.what: roughly 0.27 SOL is stranded and unrecoverable on devnet
operational_defect_found.how: the probe generated its depositor and its three multisig members in process and funded them before doing any work — 0.15 SOL to the depositor and 0.12 SOL to the multisig's vault PDA. When the run crashed, those keys were discarded with it, so nothing can move that balance again.
operational_defect_found.why_it_matters_beyond_devnet: the amounts were over-provisioned by roughly ten times what the accounts actually needed, and the loss was caused by the combination of over-funding and ephemeral keys. On a real network either mistake alone is affordable; together they are not.
operational_defect_found.repair: fund ephemeral accounts with the measured minimum, and write ephemeral keys to disk outside every repository for the duration of a run so a crash is recoverable rather than terminal

known_limits: a public cluster has no time control, so the 730-day cliff, the 30-day notice, the 90-day rotation notice and the silence grace cannot complete on devnet and were not exercised
devnet is subject to ledger resets; this receipt is not a permanent object
the Squads authority compatibility result remains the local one in evidence/B2_SQUADS_AUTHORITY_2026-08-20.json; it has not been reproduced on a public cluster
no independent party has run or reviewed anything here
no mainnet, no production key, no production ceremony, no audit
